payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterative bottom-up DP with dp[i][j] = min cost for j displays ending at index i. For j=1..3, for each i, check previous k: if j=1 or s[k]<s[i], update min.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a 2D table (index, length) and nested loops to compute minimum cost for increasing subsequence of length 3. Characteristic of dp_2d_state.
